from.place: Morphisms of the rationalization: scalar powers dominate torsion-cone denominators, and the resulting localized Hom formula

title: Scalar fractions and equality in a Verdier rationalization
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\mathcal T$ an $R$-linear triangulated category [def-weil-linear-category], [def-weil-triangulated-category], with $R$-linear integer shifts. Let $M\subseteq R$ be a submonoid and let $Q:\mathcal T\to\mathcal T[M^{-1}]$ be the rationalization functor of [sk-def-sfb-rationalization]. For every $K,L\in\mathcal T$ the following hold.

1. For every $\alpha:QK\to QL$ there are $m\in M$ and $f:K\to L$ such that $m\alpha=Q(f)$.
2. For every $f,g:K\to L$, one has $Q(f)=Q(g)$ if and only if there is $m\in M$ with $mf=mg$.
